operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: IDF Strikes Continue on Day 964 as Hamas Warns of 'Dangerous Escalation'
heroSubtitle: On Day 963 (May 31, 2026), an Israeli Apache helicopter struck a crowded cafe at the Gaza seaport, killing 2 and wounding 12 — as daily strikes continue across the Strip. On Day 962 (May 30): an Israeli strike killed a Palestinian doctor and wounded three. On Day 961 (May 29): Netanyahu announced a directive for the IDF to extend territorial control from 60% to 70% of Gaza, drawing concern from Germany and the UN. Day 960 (May 28): IDF strike on a Gaza City residential building killed 10 including 4 children; Hamas Gaza City Brigade deputy commander Aslim was killed in a separate strike. The US reinstated sanctions on UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese. Ceasefire Phase II talks remain deadlocked, 470,000 face IPC Phase 5 catastrophic hunger, and Israel's new Mossad Director Gofman takes over on June 2.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, Reuters, Bloomberg, Haaretz, IMEMC, WAFA, WFP, CBS News, Washington Post, Palestine Chronicle, UN News, Arab News, Al-Monitor. Gaza death toll: 74,000+ confirmed killed since Oct 7, 2023. Day 964 (Jun 1): IDF strikes continue; Hamas warns 'dangerous escalation'; new Mossad Dir Gofman takes over Jun 2. Day 963 (May 31): Apache strike on Gaza seaport cafe — 2 killed, 12 wounded. Day 962 (May 30): Israeli strike kills Palestinian doctor, wounds 3. Day 961 (May 29): Netanyahu 70% Gaza territorial directive; 6+ killed in continued strikes; Germany expresses concern. Day 960 (May 28): IDF strikes Gaza City residential building — 10 killed including 4 children, 20+ wounded; Hamas Zeitoun Bn commander Aslim killed; US sanctions Albanese reinstated. Day 959 (May 27 / Eid): Hamas confirms Odeh's death — 4th Qassam chief killed since Oct 7. Day 958 (May 26 / Eid eve): Tel al-Sultan camp bombed 45+ killed Rafah; Odeh killed with family Gaza City; Egyptian soldier killed border skirmish. UNRWA staff killed: 391. IDF controls 60%+ Gaza; directive to 70% issued.
